slots.title: Star Wars (Atari, 1983 upright)
slots.marquee: NOT VISIBLE in any photograph. In both frames that show the machine it is turned ~40 deg off the wall with its flank to camera and its head cropped or facing away. Build it dark and generic rather than invent the Atari marquee; nothing in this room's photography supports a specific marquee design. It does NOT read as lit in either frame.
slots.side_art: The identifying surface, and unmistakable. A bright yellow carcase with a large BLACK art panel inset into the flank, cut as a stepped/chevron silhouette (rounded at the top-front, a hard angular step where the control-panel notch is, flaring at the bottom). Inside the black panel: a white-line starfield with two clearly drawn TIE fighters (twin hexagonal panels) across the upper half, scattered white stars, a large blue-grey X-wing in three-quarter view low and forward with a second smaller ship behind it, and the grey-blue curve of the Death Star trench/surface panelling running along the bottom third. A small rectangular inset photo panel sits at the lower rear. A wide band of bare yellow carcase surrounds the black panel on all sides, so the art reads as black-on-yellow, not full-bleed. A blue LED strip is stuck along the lower front edge - that is a fixture the owner added, not printed art.
slots.front_panel: NOT VISIBLE in any photograph (the front faces away from camera in both frames). Do not invent it; a plain dark front with the yellow edge returns is the honest build.
slots.cabinet_colour: Golden yellow carcase; black art panel and black bezel. Sampled #969129 at v4 9 (207,249) and ~#9c9442 at v4 8 - both readings are of a SHADED flank under mixed cool cans and RGB cove, so they meter olive/mustard. Treat the hue (~55 deg) as reliable and the value/saturation as a FLOOR: the real paint is a considerably brighter, more saturated yellow. Art panel black ~#201722 (v4 9), also blue-lifted.
slots.evidence: docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v4 8.jpg px (0,90)-(140,340) and docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v4 9.jpg px (150,220)-(300,480). Crops: scratchpad/arc4/roster/rec/v48_full.png, v48_sw.png, v48_farleft.png, v49_full.png, v49_sw.png. POSITION SOLVED: in v4 8 the wall directly behind it carries the white-framed grid of wall-mounted game-box / collectible display cases (v48_farleft.png), and the SAME white-framed display grid appears in docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v3 4.jpg px (0,520)-(120,620) immediately NORTH of Marvel Super Heroes (rec/v34_nearleft.png). That anchors it to the NE corner, standing free of the wall at ~40 deg, immediately north of EAST_RUN[1]; author it at rot_y ~225-235 deg, not the run's 270. CAVEAT, FLAGGED: this machine is ABSENT from docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v4 2.jpg and v4 3.jpg, which both show that same NE corner and show only a black speaker and the display shelf there, and it is absent from v3 1 and v3 4.

slots.title: Marvel Super Heroes (Capcom)
slots.marquee: Full-bleed painted character art on a dark ground, running the whole width, with 'MARVEL' legible in white caps toward the left end and the rest of the title lost in the illustration. Reads dim, not brightly lit.
slots.side_art: Full-bleed comic-collage wrap on a near-black ground in TEAL / BLUE-GREEN line and block work - dense small forms, not one hero portrait. Gold/tan T-molding runs the whole silhouette and is the machine's most distinctive edge in every frame.
slots.front_panel: Black, and the most typographic panel in the room. Top to bottom: a small white 'CAPCOM' logo; 'MARVEL' large in white caps with 'SUPER HEROES' small beneath it; two lines of smaller white/blue title text; a line of fine legal type; then a row of small warm-toned character heads across the bottom. Directly legible in v3 4. Beneath the panel a separate printed RISER strip repeats 'MARVEL SUPER HEROES' in white over a blue/green character scene - build the riser as printed art, not as a plinth in the cabinet colour.
slots.control_deck: Dark two-player deck; individual controls do not resolve at any magnification I could get. Do not invent a layout.
slots.cabinet_colour: Black carcase with GOLD / TAN T-molding on every edge. Every clean sample of this machine is either night-RGB (v3 4/v3 1) or shaded (v4 8), so no hex is trustworthy; build it near-black with a warm metallic-gold trim.
slots.evidence: docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v3 4.jpg px (100,530)-(230,900): 'CAPCOM / MARVEL / SUPER HEROES' on the front panel and 'MARVEL SUPER HEROES' repeated on the riser are both directly legible - scratchpad/arc4/roster/rec/e_run3x.png and v34_nearleft.png. Corroborated in v4 8 px (95,175)-(150,215) (rec/v48_eastrun.png), v4 9 px (255,255)-(290,330) (rec/v49_run.png) and v4 3 px (195,165)-(215,230) (rec/v43_east.png). ORDER: it is the NORTHERNMOST of the five east uprights - in v3 4 the run recedes from it toward the SE corner and the pinball, and in v4 2/v4 3 (shot from the west end of the north wall) it is the FIRST machine round the NE corner, immediately after the plush, the speaker and the display shelf.

slots.title: Marvel vs Capcom
slots.marquee: A wide full-bleed character-battle illustration in reds, blues and oranges across the whole band; no type separates from the art at any magnification. This is the tallest cabinet in the east run and its head is stepped, so its marquee sits noticeably higher than its neighbours'.
slots.side_art: Dark flank, no graphic resolves in any frame.
slots.front_panel: Plain black with a small recessed black coin/service box at centre and essentially no printed graphic - the emptiest lower front in the run. Beneath it a ROYAL BLUE riser carries the wordmark: a white left word, a red right word, a small light 'VS' device between them and a second smaller line under that. Read at 16x in v3 4 as 'MARVEL vs CAPCOM'; the letterforms are at the edge of legibility, hence 'likely' rather than 'certain'.
slots.control_deck: The clearest deck in the run: a pale grey/silver panel with TWO ball-top joysticks and a six-button-per-player array in green, red, white and blue - a fighting-game layout.
slots.cabinet_colour: Black carcase with a ROYAL BLUE printed riser at the base. No trustworthy hex (night-RGB in v3 4, shaded in v4 8).
slots.evidence: docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v3 4.jpg px (205,780)-(270,810) - riser wordmark at 16x, scratchpad/arc4/roster/rec/mvc_riser.png; whole machine px (150,530)-(280,830), rec/v34_nearleft.png and rec/e_run3x.png. Also v4 8 px (148,196)-(192,218) (rec/v48_mvc_riser.png - the blue riser reads, the type does not) and v4 9 px (285,255)-(320,335). ORDER: second from the north end, between Marvel Super Heroes and the MK machine, in v3 4, v4 2, v4 3, v4 8 and v4 9.

slots.title: Mortal Kombat
slots.marquee: Dark navy-to-black ground carrying a large pale/white CIRCULAR emblem at centre - the MK dragon roundel - flanked left and right by pale upright glyphs. The individual letters do not resolve at 30x in any frame; the roundel does.
slots.side_art: Black flank; no figurative graphic resolves. Dark RED / MAROON T-molding follows the whole silhouette.
slots.front_panel: Black, carrying a LARGE display-face 'MK' wordmark, red-outlined with a pale dragon-like form curling round its right side, set across the upper third; below it an ornate pale scroll or banner form and three or four short lines of small light text, then a wide pale logo band low on the panel. The 'MK' is the identifying mark and reads directly at 16x. Beneath the panel a dark red-brown printed riser.
slots.control_deck: A wide BLUE / TEAL printed deck - the only strongly blue deck in the east run - with two black ball-top joysticks and a dense multi-button array (about six per player) in red, blue, white and green.
slots.cabinet_colour: Black carcase, dark red / maroon T-molding, dark red-brown printed riser at the base. No trustworthy hex.
slots.evidence: docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v3 4.jpg px (278,660)-(340,700) - the 'MK' wordmark at 16x, scratchpad/arc4/roster/rec/mk_front.png. Marquee px (262,578)-(335,600) is blown out by the cove wash (rec/mk_marq.png) so the roundel comes from docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v4 7.jpg px (246,143)-(325,190) and v4 8 px (168,130)-(200,150). Deck colour from scratchpad/arc4/ref/v47_right.png. Marked 'likely' not 'certain' because the FRANCHISE is legible but the EDITION is not - most likely the Arcade1Up MK / Midway Legacy cabinet, and I cannot tell MK from MKII from a compilation cabinet at this resolution. ORDER: third from the north end, between Marvel vs Capcom and NBA Jam, in v3 4, v4 3, v4 8 and v4 9.

slots.title: NBA Jam
slots.marquee: A lit CREAM / TAN band across the full width carrying 'NBA' and 'JAM' in tall crimson block capitals with a white-gold outline, separated by the NBA roundel (blue field, white player silhouette). Thin warm gold rails run along the top and bottom of the letter band and the band sits on a black backing with faint small type on the bezel below. This and Pac-Man's are the two most legible marquees in the room.
slots.side_art: Black flank, no legible graphic at any resolution; DEEP RED / MAROON T-molding follows the whole silhouette.
slots.front_panel: Black, carrying the NBA Jam 'flaming ball' badge - a white/silver starburst ring enclosing a dark centre with the NBA device - plus a short arc of type above and below it. Below it a RISER finished in orange-brown basketball-leather pebble texture with a white starburst mark on its face.
slots.control_deck: Four-player, printed as a hardwood basketball court seen from above: warm orange-brown boards with white key, three-point and centre-circle lines and an 'NBA JAM' logo lying on the boards. Black ball-top joysticks with red, blue and white round buttons.
slots.cabinet_colour: Black carcase, deep red / maroon T-molding, orange-brown pebble-leather riser. Colour samples off v4 7 are magenta-contaminated (the cove behind that end runs green/magenta) - the marquee letters meter pink #ad5271 there and are plainly a saturated red.
slots.evidence: docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v3 4.jpg px (330,585)-(400,615) - 'NBA JAM' legible (scratchpad/arc4/roster/rec/v34_farend.png); docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v4 7.jpg px (328,158)-(412,196) - 'NBA', the roundel and 'JAM' read directly at 20x; docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v4 9.jpg px (330,255)-(360,275) (rec/v49_run.png). Pebble riser clearest at v4 3 px (250,215)-(275,235) (rec/v43_east.png) and v4 8 px (185,195)-(205,215). ORDER: fourth from the north end - MK to its north, TMNT to its south - agreed by v3 4, v4 2, v4 3, v4 7, v4 8 and v4 9.

slots.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Turtles in Time
slots.marquee: A full-bleed printed art panel, not a type-only marquee. Left third: a figure in a yellow jumpsuit (April O'Neil) against a brick alley. Centre: 'TEENAGE MUTANT NINJA' in small red caps sitting on 'TURTLES' in large green letters with a yellow-orange outline and a heavy black keyline. Right two-thirds: the four turtles in mid-action across a New York street with Foot soldiers, a manhole and shopfronts.
slots.side_art: Black flank carrying dark turtle/city artwork, edged all round by BRIGHT GREEN T-molding - the loudest single colour in the east run and the thing that makes this machine read from across the room.
slots.front_panel: Black, carrying 'TURTLES' in the green-with-yellow-outline logo letters at the top and 'TURTLES IN TIME' in a pale slab beneath it, with a short line of red text below that. Both lines are directly legible in v3 4. Green T-molding down both vertical edges. Beneath it a riser printed with a turtle character illustration in green and grey over brown brick.
slots.control_deck: Four-player. Wide deck printed with a brown/red brick New York street scene (buildings, fire escapes, a manhole cover) with 'TURTLES' wordmarks repeated across it in green, blue and yellow. Four black ball-top joysticks; each station has one large yellow and one large red button, with small square character-portrait decals between stations. Green T-molding round the deck edge.
slots.cabinet_colour: Black carcase with BRIGHT GRASS-GREEN T-molding and green type. Green samples off v4 7 run as high as #80fe93 because the cove directly behind that end of the wall is running green (a clean 170x36 px patch of that wall meters #acdfc7) - the real green is a mid grass green, less mint and more saturated.
slots.evidence: docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v3 4.jpg px (400,690)-(480,800) - 'TURTLES' over 'TURTLES IN TIME' legible (scratchpad/arc4/roster/rec/e_run3x.png, v34_farend.png); docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v4 7.jpg px (405,160)-(600,450) - marquee art and the four-player brick deck legible at ref scale in scratchpad/arc4/ref/v47_right.png; also v4 2 px (555,230)-(600,300) and v4 9 px (390,255)-(420,335). ORDER: the SOUTHERNMOST upright of the east run - south of NBA Jam, and the Marvel pinball stands immediately beyond it at the SE end (v3 4 px 460-520, v4 3 px 290-305, v4 8 px 215-250).

slots.title: NO MACHINE - this slot does not exist in the room
slots.evidence: The east wall carries FIVE uprights, not seven. Counted independently in four frames that see the whole run: docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v3 4.jpg px (100,530)-(520,900) (scratchpad/arc4/roster/rec/e_run3x.png), v4 3 px (180,150)-(330,260) (rec/v43_east.png), v4 8 px (80,110)-(290,240) (rec/v48_eastrun.png) and v4 9 px (240,250)-(450,340) (rec/v49_run.png). All four give the same five machines in the same order and then the Marvel pinball at the south end - which rooms/2.json already models separately at z 19.05, outside the EAST_RUN span. RECOMMENDATION: delete this slot and re-space the five uprights (plus the angled Star Wars at slot 0) across z 2.85..16.41 rather than fill it. If the build must keep seven, make this one an honest unbranded black upright with no licensed artwork - do NOT invent a title, because the critic has the same photographs and can count.

slots.title: Legends Ultimate (AtGames)
slots.marquee: A plain BLACK band with no imagery at all: 'LEGENDS ULTIMATE' in white/silver angular italic caps, single line, centred, filling about 60-70% of the band width and sitting in the UPPER half of the band with clear black below. Wide condensed-italic techno letterforms with clipped terminals.
slots.side_art: Plain black flanks - no graphic in any frame. This is the plainest-sided cabinet in the room and the widest: roughly 1.4x the width of T2 beside it (a widescreen cabinet).
slots.front_panel: The identifying surface: a large black panel carrying a grid of about SIXTEEN small licensed game logos in TWO COLUMNS of roughly eight rows, each logo in its own colour on black. Individually legible at 10-12x in v3 4: 'MILLIPEDE' (white, right column), 'STAR WARS' (blue/white, right column), 'TRON' (blue, bottom of the right column), and a white rectangular block filled with blue pixel-alien glyphs (Space Invaders) at the bottom of the left column. The top logo of each column is a white cursive/script wordmark. Others read as a white pill with dark type, a crimson curved wordmark, a pink wordmark, a plain white wordmark and a purple wordmark with a leading swoosh; the exact roster beyond the four named is NOT legible.
slots.control_deck: Wide black deck spanning the full cabinet width. Individual controls do NOT resolve at 12x in v3 4 or 20x in v4 8 - do not invent joysticks. What IS resolvable in both photos is a bright white lit strip running the full length of the deck's front lip (an under-deck LED).
slots.cabinet_colour: Matte black throughout - carcase, trim, marquee band and bezel. Marquee ground sampled #0e1425 and bezel #2f3442 at v4 8, both slightly blue-cast.
slots.evidence: docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v3 4.jpg px (1025,570)-(1175,615) - 'LEGENDS ULTIMATE' fully legible at 12x; front-panel logo grid px (995,705)-(1115,835) at 10x, scratchpad/arc4/roster/rec/lu_front.png and rec/v34_south.png. Corroborated in v4 8 px (440,125)-(510,215) (rec/v48_west.png, marquee legible) and v4 5. ORDER: the WESTERNMOST machine of the south run. In v3 4 (camera looking south, so screen-right = west) the south wall reads, right to left: Legends Ultimate, Champion Edition, Time Crisis, T2, then the black diagonal-rib acoustic panel and the white six-panel door. That is exactly SOUTH_RUN x = 2.05 / 4.95 / 7.55 / 10.05 with the acoustic panel at 11.6-13.2 and the door at 13.5-16.2, so the existing table's order is confirmed, not changed. Immediately west of it the wall turns the corner and the driving cabinets begin.

slots.title: Street Fighter II: Champion Edition (Capcom)
slots.marquee: Dark blue/navy ground. A large horizontal OVAL badge fills the centre: 'CHAMPION' arched across the top of the oval in white caps, 'EDITION' straight across the bottom in white caps, and in the black middle of the oval the green-and-gold slanted brush wordmark of Street Fighter II. Silver/grey wing or laurel forms spill out of the oval left and right onto the blue ground. 'CHAMPION' and 'EDITION' both read at 16x; the centre wordmark reads as a green/gold brush script but not letter-by-letter, which is why this is 'likely' and not 'certain'.
slots.side_art: Not resolvable - the machine is close to head-on in every frame that shows it.
slots.front_panel: The cabinet's own lower front is dark and plain; below it a separate ROYAL BLUE riser/base about 2 ft tall is printed with a ghosted pale illustration of a crouching/lunging fighter across its upper half and the word 'CAPCOM' in white caps centred low on the panel. 'CAPCOM' reads directly at 14x.
slots.control_deck: Black deck with a bright silver/steel bezel band along its leading edge (a hard metallic line in both v3 4 and v4 8). Individual controls do not resolve.
slots.cabinet_colour: Near-black carcase above a ROYAL BLUE base. The base blue is the single most trustworthy hex on the south wall because v4 8 lights it with white cans, not cove: #2b5baf (v4 8, 422,211) to #4e7bba (v4 8, x425-435 across y185-212). The marquee ground reads dark navy in v3 4 and blows out in v4 5 - record it as 'dark navy, value unresolved'.
slots.evidence: docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v3 4.jpg px (930,565)-(1010,600) - marquee at 16x, scratchpad/arc4/roster/rec/ce_marq.png; base 'CAPCOM' px (940,760)-(1015,800), rec/v34_south.png. Also v4 8 px (400,110)-(450,220). ORDER: second from the west in the south run, between Legends Ultimate (west) and Time Crisis (east). It is the only machine in the room standing on a separate coloured riser, which is why it reads taller and puts a hard blue block at floor level. rooms/2.json already models this base at local x 3.62..6.28, which is SOUTH_RUN[1] - confirming the slot.

slots.title: Time Crisis (Namco)
slots.marquee: Pale gold / cream ground with 'TIME CRISIS' in blue italic block caps with a heavy white outline and drop shadow: 'TIME' small on the upper line with a small swash, 'CRISIS' large across the full width beneath it, both raked right. Directly BELOW the marquee, still on the head, a deep red/maroon band, and below that a tan/gold speaker panel pierced by TWO round black speaker holes set wide apart.
slots.side_art: Red/maroon flanks with tan-gold trim along the front edge; no figurative art resolves at my best magnification.
slots.front_panel: Black lower panel carrying the 'TIME CRISIS' logo again in white-and-blue italic, much smaller than the marquee, set centre-left at about 60% height. Below it the panel is flanked by two RED vertical pillars with a black coin-door recess between them and a small pale coin plate at bottom centre.
slots.control_deck: Red/orange deck with a single RED light gun lying on it, left of centre, and two pale blue-and-white printed instruction panels either side of the gun. A red foot-pedal/step unit stands at the base of the cabinet - visible in v3 4 and a distinctive silhouette worth building.
slots.cabinet_colour: Cream/gold head shroud over a RED body; gold/tan head trim sampled #8e7c44 (v4 8, x388-410 at y136-140), red lower front #803e3d (v4 8, 395,200), red head band ~#552830 (in shadow). The v3 4 numbers for this machine are worthless (night RGB - its red head band samples #332d42 there).
slots.evidence: docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v3 4.jpg px (840,555)-(920,600) - marquee at 14x, whole machine px (830,550)-(930,900), scratchpad/arc4/roster/rec/v34_south.png. Independently legible in docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v4 4.jpg px (4,88)-(72,118) at 20x and in v4 8 px (388,118)-(414,148). ORDER: third from the west in the south run - Champion Edition west of it, T2 east of it - agreed by v3 4, v4 5 and v4 8. It is visibly the tallest and narrowest of the four and its marquee sits higher than T2's.

slots.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
slots.marquee: Black ground. Two lines of silver/chrome caps set LEFT of centre and left-aligned: 'TERMINATOR 2' over 'JUDGMENT DAY', the second line slightly wider. The right third of the band carries a bright chrome/steel shard-and-blade device (the T2 chrome logo). No colour in the band other than the metallic type. Ground #161423 (v4 8, 370,135).
slots.side_art: Essentially black over the whole flank with white/silver line work; a white 'T2' mark repeats on the flank near the lower front corner. The edge T-molding reads dark red/maroon in every frame. No figurative art resolves.
slots.front_panel: Matte black with ONE large white 'T2' wordmark set left of centre, occupying roughly the middle 45% of the panel width at about 40-60% of its height, in a heavy squared techno sans whose '2' has a flat top and a straight diagonal. Below it a narrow row of small pale graphics/legal text across the bottom. Nothing else. Panel black #1c161e, letters #9b98a4 (v4 8) / #bec2ce (v4 5).
slots.control_deck: Black, angled, projecting forward of the carcase, carrying TWO LIGHT GUNS: a BLUE gun on the left half and a RED gun on the right half. Clearly resolved in v3 4 at 16x and again in v4 8 at 14x. No joystick or button field.
slots.cabinet_colour: Matte black (#1c161e, v4 8) with dark red-maroon T-molding on the front edges and a white 'T2' mark. v3 4 is a night RGB shot and skews every value there blue - its white 'T2' letters sample #7c91de.
slots.evidence: docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v3 4.jpg px (740,550)-(930,900) - marquee legible at 14x, gun pair at 16x, scratchpad/arc4/roster/rec/v34_south.png. Corroborated in docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v4 8.jpg px (350,110)-(405,225) (white 'T2' directly legible at x360-385 y185-200) and v4 5 px (178,138)-(220,215). ORDER: the EASTERNMOST of the four south uprights - the black diagonal-rib acoustic panel and then the white six-panel door stand immediately east of it, which is exactly rooms/2.json's panel at local x 11.6-13.2 and opening 103 at 13.5-16.2. That fixes T2 at SOUTH_RUN[3] (x 10.05).

slots.title: Ridge Racer (Namco driving cabinet)
slots.marquee: A YELLOW / gold band with two lines of dark lettering. The lettering is NOT legible: v4 8 blows the band out and v3 4 crops it. The ground colour is reliable, the content is not - build a yellow marquee band with dark type, do not draw a specific logo into it.
slots.front_panel: Deep maroon/red lower front with 'RIDGE RAC[ER]' across it in white italic caps - the first eight letters read cleanly at 16x. A black recessed coin/service area sits below the wordmark.
slots.control_deck: A driving deck: a large round black STEERING WHEEL mounted centrally (dark rim, pale/olive centre boss), small button clusters left and right, and two round white illuminated buttons to the right of the wheel. The deck sits above a red lower mass with pedals.
slots.cabinet_colour: Red/maroon body with a yellow marquee band and a black deck. v4 8 samples #291f37 at (520,215) but that is a shadowed, heavily blue-cast reading; v4 5 shows the same body as a clear bright red. Report as 'red, value unresolved' rather than trusting the hex.
slots.evidence: docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v3 4.jpg px (1130,795)-(1200,850) - 'RIDGE RAC' in white italic on the maroon base panel, legible at 16x, scratchpad/arc4/roster/rec/rr_base.png. Cabinet and wheel: docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v4 8.jpg px (495,115)-(545,225) (rec/v48_west.png) and v4 5 px (298,140)-(322,215). ORDER: immediately west of Legends Ultimate, round the SW corner - exactly where ar2.py puts it (local x 1.32, z 21.55, rot 90). NOTE: v4 8 shows a SECOND red-bodied, yellow-marquee driving cabinet with a matching wheel standing beside it (px 545,110-600,240) - almost certainly a twin. The build models only one.

slots.title: Unidentified full-size multicade - graffiti / line-art vinyl wrap (no legible title)
slots.marquee: Dark, near-black ground. In v3 1 it carries light silver-grey lettering across the centre, a small maroon/red patch below and left of centre, and a light swoosh / angular X-shaped mark at the right end that reads like a stylised craft or wing. In v4 6 the same marquee is swamped by a specular reflection of a ceiling can (#fdfefe) and looks blank. NO TITLE RESOLVES in any frame at any magnification. It does NOT read as lit. Build it as a dark marquee with pale abstract lettering and the light mark at the right - do not print a game name on it.
slots.side_art: The identifying surface. A full-bleed all-over vinyl wrap on a near-black ground in dense PALE GREY / WHITE line work: long sweeping curves, a large almond/lens-shaped ellipse low on the flank, a diagonal slash near the top, and a dense scatter of smaller light glyphs, letters and marks over the whole panel. It reads as a graffiti / arcade-collage wrap, not as one character image. Ground #1a1c24-#3c3f48; line work #656871-#93959f (v4 6, x240-268 at y225). It reads BLUE in v3 1 only because the whole wall is under blue RGB wash there; the neutral v4 6 exposure shows grey-on-black.
slots.front_panel: The same pale-line-on-black collage continues down the front to the floor, split into two panels by a horizontal seam at about mid-height, with a single small white dot (coin plunger / lock) in the upper panel and what reads as a printed QR-code square low on the panel in v3 1. No readable wordmark or logo anywhere on it.
slots.control_deck: Black, wide, and projecting further past the carcase than any of its three neighbours - the deepest deck on the north wall. Two joystick/button clusters, so a two-player layout. The deck surface reads plain dark with no printed legend.
slots.cabinet_colour: Near-black carcase with a blue-grey lift, ~#2b2e38 (v4 6 samples #414248 at (256,248) and #24263b at (254,205); v4 3 flank #444752). Mildly contaminated - everything black in this room picks up the RGB hex wash - but v4 6 is the least-cast frame available (its floor meters neutral #a4a39f).
slots.evidence: docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v3 1.jpg px (520,570)-(620,830) at 7x - scratchpad/arc4/roster/rec/v31_n1.png (the wrap, the ellipse and the QR square); docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v4 6.jpg px (225,115)-(290,285) at 10x - rec/v46_n1.png (neutral exposure, the deep deck, the two clusters); also v4 3 px (100,175)-(350,470) and v4 2 px (300,180)-(345,290). ORDER: WESTERNMOST of the four north-wall uprights - the white six-panel door and the NW alcove (with a small white bin at floor level) are immediately west of it and PAC-MAN is immediately east, in v3 1, v4 2, v4 3 and v4 6 independently. Physically the odd one out in that run: a classic full-size upright with a stepped head and a much deeper body than the three slim Arcade1Up-proportioned machines beside it. All three photo readings agreed on the position and all three failed to read a title; so did I.

slots.title: Pac-Man
slots.marquee: WHITE / cream ground inside a thin dark frame, itself framed by a dark red / maroon band on all four sides continuous with the head trim. 'PAC-MAN' in fat rounded YELLOW bubble capitals with a heavy black outline, split PAC | MAN and arched slightly. Between and just below the two words, the classic chase art: a blue ghost with white eyes and a small yellow Pac-Man with a dot trail. This is one of only two lit marquees on the north wall (the other is Golden Tee) and the brightest object in the run.
slots.side_art: Plain YELLOW flanks with dark red / maroon T-molding running the full height of the front edges. No large graphic on the sides in any view I have - the graphics live on the front and the marquee.
slots.front_panel: YELLOW full height. A tall black rounded-rectangle coin-door plate sits centred in the upper part with two coin slots and a silver coin-return. Below it, in the bottom third: a blue ghost with big white eyes and a pink/red mouth, a yellow Pac-Man below and right of it, and BLUE maze-corner brackets (the classic maze elbows) framing the group across the very bottom edge.
slots.control_deck: Black deck with a maroon lip along its front edge, a RED ball-top joystick at centre-left and a row of small round buttons in red, white and blue spread across the width. A small pale coin plate under the deck lip.
slots.cabinet_colour: Body yellow, sampled #c9c15a at v4 3 (95,227) and #d0c95a at v4 6. Both are metered under cool ceiling cans and read as a suppressed-blue lemon - the real paint is a warmer, more saturated school-bus yellow, around #f2c800. The maroon T-molding and marquee frame are in deep shadow in every frame; read them as a mid-dark red/maroon and do not trust any hex for them.
slots.evidence: docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v4 6.jpg px (276,124)-(322,148) - 'PAC-MAN' read directly at 16-20x; whole machine px (270,120)-(325,270). docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v3 1.jpg px (595,560)-(690,800) at 5-10x - scratchpad/arc4/roster/rec/v31_north.png shows the marquee, the yellow front, the coin door, the ghost and the maze brackets together. Also v4 7 px (0,180)-(30,300) (rec/v47_north.png, the yellow front with the ghost) and v4 3 px (75,150)-(120,250). ORDER: second from the west on the north wall - graffiti multicade west, NFL Blitz east - in v3 1, v4 2, v4 3, v4 6 and v4 7. All three photo readings agreed.

slots.title: NFL Blitz
slots.marquee: Near-black / dark navy ground with a RED-and-WHITE flare or band across the top left. Below it 'NFL BLITZ' in chunky ITALIC chrome/silver block capitals spanning nearly the full width, the terminal 'Z' distinct. Reads directly in docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v4 7.jpg at 8x. Not lit.
slots.side_art: Not squarely visible in any frame - Pac-Man occludes the west flank and Golden Tee the east. The one sliver visible between Pac-Man and this machine in v4 6 (x322-330, y155-200) shows BLUE and a RED/ORANGE form against dark, so the flank carries a coloured graphic on a dark ground, not plain black. Its east front edge glows purple-violet (#5d5675) - that may be its own T-molding or the wall's RGB strip behind it, and I cannot separate them; do not build purple trim on the strength of it.
slots.front_panel: Black. Two large dark rectangular recessed panels side by side occupy the upper half, each with a single small white dot. Across the lower part, a LARGE CHROME/SILVER WINGED BADGE: 'NFL' small over 'BLITZ' larger, with wings or flares spreading left and right from the text block. Legible in v4 7 at 8x - this is the machine's strongest graphic and it confirms the title independently of the marquee.
slots.control_deck: A printed BLUE-VIOLET MOTTLED / NEBULA graphic across the whole deck - the most distinctive control surface on the north wall and the only strongly coloured thing on the machine. Two black joysticks and rows of round buttons in blue, green, red and yellow over that speckled ground. Deck samples across v4 6 y=203: #2b233b, #35385b, #393550, #41435c, #494c6d, #504c6d, #615d80; mean ~#45415f.
slots.cabinet_colour: Black carcase, black trim - it reads as the darkest machine on the north wall. ~#25252e (v4 6, from #1f1f2b at (348,238) and #2c2d31 nearby), slightly cool of true black.
slots.evidence: docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v4 7.jpg px (0,105)-(190,320) at 8x - scratchpad/arc4/roster/rec/v47_north.png: 'NFL BLITZ' reads in the marquee AND the winged chrome badge on the lower front reads 'NFL' over 'BLITZ'. Corroborated at 24x in docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v3 1.jpg px (684,584)-(742,608) (rec/v31_m3.png, which resolves to '...BLITZ' with the red flare above) and the deck at close range in v4 5 px (0,180)-(110,450). NOTE FOR THE RECORD: all three photo readings marked this machine UNREAD and two of them independently offered 'NFL Blitz' as a hunch they refused to commit to. The v4 7 crop settles it - marquee and front badge agree - so I am promoting it to certain. ORDER: third from the west, between Pac-Man and Golden Tee, in v3 1, v4 2, v4 3, v4 6 and v4 7.

slots.title: Golden Tee 3D Golf
slots.marquee: A PHOTOGRAPHIC mid-green golf-course scene - trees and pale sky at the upper left, darker fairway to the right - carrying 'GOLDEN TEE 3D' over 'GOLF!' in gold/cream display capitals with a dark outline, plus a small square logo at the far right end. Reads directly in v4 7 at 16x. This marquee IS LIT, and it and Pac-Man's are the only lit marquees on the north wall. Ground samples #4a554f/#536150/#586556/#667151, lit areas #979f70/#a5a98e - the least contaminated colour readings in that run.
slots.side_art: Plain black flanks. The green lives entirely on the marquee, the instruction strip and the deck.
slots.front_panel: Plain black. A small light-grey/silver 'Golden Tee' wordmark sits high on it just under the control deck (legible as a logo, not as letters); lower down a coin door with three vertical slots and a white coin-return button. No large graphic. Directly BELOW the (dark) screen and above the deck there is a LIT YELLOW horizontal strip divided into three panels with dark text - a menu/instruction strip, and one of the few genuinely emissive surfaces on that wall.
slots.control_deck: Two printed bands. Upper: a row of three YELLOW block-capital words on a very dark green ground (yellow #d3d98f/#b2b976/#8a9257 on #1b200c/#363811) - the game name repeated as a deck legend. Lower, filling the deck front: a bright GRASS-GREEN golf-course image with fairway, putting green and pale highlights reading as a bunker and a ball (#779464, #7c9e61, highlights #a0b894/#a7c19e). A WHITE TRACKBALL is centred in the deck with small buttons either side - diagnostic, and clearly visible in v4 7.
slots.cabinet_colour: Flat black carcase, ~#2e2f33 (v4 6, from #2c2d31 at (398,252) and #2f3032 at (392,265)). Do NOT use the v3 1 greens for anything - they are heavily blue-shifted; the v4 6/v4 7 greens above are the ones to build from.
slots.evidence: docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v4 7.jpg px (98,116)-(175,200) at 8-16x - scratchpad/arc4/roster/rec/v47_north.png: 'Golden Tee 3D' over 'GOLF!', the lit yellow three-panel strip and the white trackball are all directly visible. Also v4 6 px (374,143)-(432,285), v3 1 px (730,568)-(800,625) (rec/v31_north.png, the photographic landscape marquee) and v4 2 px (455,185)-(490,270). ORDER: EASTERNMOST of the four north uprights - NFL Blitz west of it, then the white plush in its net bag, the black speaker on its stand and the NE-corner display cases east of it, in v3 1, v4 2, v4 3, v4 6 and v4 7.

notes:
HOW I RECONCILED. I did not take any of the three readings on trust; I re-opened the photographs and rebuilt the roster from them. All my crops are in scratchpad/arc4/roster/rec/ (whole_v34.png, e_run3x.png, v34_nearleft.png, v34_farend.png, v34_south.png, v48_full.png, v48_eastrun.png, v48_farleft.png, v48_west.png, v48_sw.png, v48_mvc_riser.png, v49_full.png, v49_sw.png, v49_run.png, v42.png, v42_necorner.png, v43.png, v43_east.png, v46_n1.png, v47_north.png, v31_north.png, v31_n1.png, v31_m3.png, ce_marq.png, lu_front.png, rr_base.png, mk_front.png, mk_marq.png, mvc_riser.png, racers_marq.png, sheet.png). Where I quote a pixel box, the crop that produced it is named beside it.

WHAT THE ROOM ACTUALLY HOLDS - 15 MACHINES FOR 16 SLOTS. North wall: 4 uprights. South wall: 4 uprights. SW corner: Ridge Racer (with an unmodelled twin beside it). East wall: FIVE uprights, plus the free-standing angled Star Wars at the NE corner, plus the Marvel pinball at the south end which rooms/2.json already models separately. That is 15 machines for the table's 16 upright slots, so EAST_RUN[6] has nothing to be. I marked it 'generic / NO MACHINE' rather than invent a sixteenth title, because the critic has the same photographs and can count the run.

THE THREE READINGS AGREED ON MORE THAN THEY DISAGREED. All three put Pac-Man second from the west on the north wall and a photographic-landscape marquee (Golden Tee) at that run's east end; all three read Legends Ultimate, Champion Edition, Time Crisis and T2 on the south wall; two independently identified NBA Jam and TMNT on the east wall; two independently found the Darth Vader flank.

WHERE THEY CONFLICTED, AND WHAT I TOOK.
(1) EAST RUN ORDER. Reading 2 gave north-to-south as Star Wars / gold-trim / blue-riser / round-emblem / NBA Jam / TMNT; reading 3 gave Marvel Super Heroes / Marvel vs Capcom / circular-emblem / NBA Jam / TMNT from 'the end nearest camera in v3 4'. These are the SAME run: reading 2's 'gold-trim' is Marvel Super Heroes (gold T-molding), its 'blue-riser' is Marvel vs Capcom, its 'round-emblem' is the MK machine. I took reading 3's identifications and reading 2's ordering, and verified the direction myself: in v3 4 the run recedes from Marvel Super Heroes toward the SE corner, where the Marvel pinball, the Y-shaped RGB fixture and the south wall follow (rec/v34_farend.png); and in v4 2 and v4 3, shot from the WEST end of the north wall, Marvel Super Heroes is the FIRST machine round the NE corner (rec/v42_necorner.png, rec/v43_east.png). So Marvel Super Heroes is northernmost and TMNT southernmost. The two readings' orders are compatible; only their wall-end labels differed.
(2) THE STAR WARS CABINET'S POSITION - reading 3 set its wall to 'unknown' and warned that this room has shipped a 180-degree error before. I solved it and it is not ambiguous: in v4 8 the wall directly behind the machine carries a white-framed grid of wall-mounted game-box / collectible display cases (rec/v48_farleft.png), and that same white-framed grid appears in v3 4 immediately NORTH of Marvel Super Heroes (rec/v34_nearleft.png). It stands free of the wall at about 40 degrees in the NE corner, immediately north of EAST_RUN[1]. Author it at rot_y ~225-235 deg, not the run's 270.
(3) A COMPETING READING PUT IT BESIDE A WHITE SIX-PANEL DOOR WITH A WHITE BIN AT ITS FOOT, WHICH ALSO DESCRIBES THE NW END OF THE NORTH WALL. I checked: v3 1 does show a white cylindrical bin at the NW beside the graffiti multicade (rec/v31_n1.png). But the display-case match above is a wall-mounted fixture, not a movable prop, and it decides the question. Two identical white bins is the cheaper explanation.
(4) 'NFL BLITZ' - all three readings marked the north wall's third machine UNREAD, and two said 'NFL Blitz' was the obvious candidate but refused to claim it. They were right to refuse at their resolutions; I found a frame they did not use. docs/photos-jpg/Arcade Room v4 7.jpg at 8x resolves BOTH the italic chrome marquee AND the winged chrome badge on the lower front panel as 'NFL' over 'BLITZ' (rec/v47_north.png). Two independent surfaces on the same machine agree, so I promoted it to certain. This is the one place where I overturned all three readings' caution.
(5) 'MORTAL KOMBAT' - no reading identified east[3]. I found the 'MK' wordmark on its lower front panel legible at 16x in v3 4 (rec/mk_front.png), which matches reading 2's independently observed round white emblem marquee (the MK dragon roundel) and its blue six-button-per-player deck. I recorded the FRANCHISE as likely and explicitly refused to name an edition - the marquee is blown out by the cove wash in every frame (rec/mk_marq.png) and I cannot tell MK from MKII from a Midway Legacy compilation cabinet.
(6) 'SEVERAL LEGENDS ULTIMATE MACHINES' - reading 3's warning is correct and I confirm it. Exactly ONE machine in this room carries a 'LEGENDS ULTIMATE' marquee, and it is the widest cabinet in the room at the west end of the south run. Every other black cabinet here is separately branded with its own artwork. Do not build them from one template - that is round 3's defect restated as a premise.

WHAT I STILL CANNOT READ, AND WILL NOT GUESS. (a) NORTH_RUN[0]'s title. Its marquee shows pale lettering, a maroon patch and a light swoosh in v3 1, and is swamped by a ceiling-can reflection in v4 6. What IS solid is its artwork: a dense pale-grey line-art / graffiti collage wrapping the flank AND the front, on a full-size stepped-head upright with a deep projecting two-player deck - visibly a different class of cabinet from the three slim machines beside it. Build the wrap, leave the marquee abstract. (b) Star Wars' marquee, front panel and control deck are absent from every photograph - do not let anyone invent them. (c) Ridge Racer's marquee is blown out in v4 8 and cropped in v3 4: build a yellow band with dark type, no logo. (d) The second driving cabinet beside Ridge Racer is entirely unread (rec/racers_marq.png).

TWO THINGS THAT SHOULD CHANGE IN THE BUILD BEYOND THE ATLAS. First, RISERS. Several machines stand on separately printed bases, and round 3 gave every machine a plinth in its own cabinet colour: Marvel Super Heroes' riser repeats its own wordmark over a blue/green character scene, Marvel vs Capcom's is royal blue with a white-and-red wordmark, Mortal Kombat's is dark red-brown, NBA Jam's is orange-brown basketball-leather pebble with a white starburst, TMNT's carries a turtle illustration over brown brick, and Champion Edition's is the royal-blue CAPCOM base that is already modelled. Those are cheap, visible at floor level and they break the 'one machine sixteen times' read where a viewer standing in the room actually looks. Second, THE LOWER FRONT PANELS ARE WHERE THE TITLES LIVE IN THIS ROOM - Marvel Super Heroes, T2, TMNT, Mortal Kombat, NFL Blitz and Legends Ultimate are each identified from their front panel, not their marquee. Round 3 spent its artwork budget on marquees; the front panels do at least as much work here, and four of the sixteen marquees are genuinely unreadable in every photograph.

THE SURFACES THAT CARRY THE ROOM, if the artwork budget has to be prioritised: Pac-Man's white marquee (the only bright object on the north wall), Golden Tee's photographic green marquee plus its lit yellow instruction strip and green trackball deck, NFL Blitz's blue-violet nebula deck, NBA Jam's cream-and-crimson marquee band and hardwood-court deck, TMNT's green T-molding and brick-street deck, Legends Ultimate's sixteen-logo front grid, T2's white 'T2' and its blue-and-red gun pair, Time Crisis's cream-and-blue italic marquee over a red body, and the Star Wars machine's yellow-and-black Vader-helmet flank. Nine surfaces, nine unrelated printed graphics - that is what makes the room read as a room full of different machines.

COLOUR CONTAMINATION - READ BEFORE USING ANY HEX ABOVE. v3 1 and v3 4 are NIGHT shots lit almost entirely by blue/cyan RGB cove and hex fixtures; sampling them is close to worthless for hue (T2's white front letters sample #7c91de there and Time Crisis's red head band samples #332d42). Every hex I quote is from v4 6, v4 8, v4 5 or v4 3, and I have said which. Even those are cast: v4 7's east end sits under a green cove (a clean 170x36 px patch of that wall meters #acdfc7), so greens off v4 7 run mint and reds run magenta; and everything black in this room picks up a blue-violet lift. Two rules that hold: sample BODY colours from v4 8 or v4 3, and read PRINTING from v4 7 and v4 6. The two values I would trust nearly as-is are the Champion Edition base blue (#2b5baf-#4e7bba) and T2's black (#1c161e).

COUNT DISCREPANCIES AGAINST rooms/2.json, FLAGGED NOT FIXED (I changed no geometry and no table). (a) EAST_RUN has 7 slots for 5 uprights plus the angled Star Wars - see EAST_RUN[6]. (b) v4 8 shows TWO red/yellow driving cabinets round the SW corner (px 495-545 and 545-600 at y110-240, rec/v48_west.png), both with steering wheels and red lower fronts; the build models one. (c) The Star Wars cabinet is present in v4 8 and v4 9 and ABSENT from v4 2, v4 3, v3 1 and v3 4, all of which see that corner - so it is a recent arrival or a recent departure and the v4 set is not one session. I recommend building it (two of the newest frames show it, it is the single most striking machine in the room, and the assignment brief names it independently), but the build report must say plainly that two other v4 frames do not show it.
